passes.name: Line-by-line scientific and leakage review; fix defects before trusting the run

findings_and_resolutions.finding: Greedy allocation candidates were limited by the fitted zone only through p=0 outside the zone; convolutional expected credit could still cause a dot to be placed just outside that zone.
findings_and_resolutions.resolution: Built an explicit allowed-zone mask, passed it to the shared allocator, and asserted no emitted dot lies outside it before scoring.

findings_and_resolutions.finding: The saved historical best shares a version label, seed, and split, but its evaluate_holdout.py hash differs from the current implementation.
findings_and_resolutions.resolution: Treat it as historical context only; no promotion comparison is claimed and the promotion condition remains false.

findings_and_resolutions.finding: The training-positive 90th-percentile zone makes training occupancy approximately 0.90 by construction.
findings_and_resolutions.resolution: Disclose that the cap shrinks about 10% but is not adaptive to test-fold support shift; never use test labels for the budget.

findings_and_resolutions.finding: The first serialized receipt's implementation_sha256 key was overwritten by pooled_summary metadata.
findings_and_resolutions.resolution: Added an explicit pipeline_implementation_sha256 and environment pin to the saved receipt, with a metadata-only correction note; did not rerun or alter scores.

findings_and_resolutions.finding: The 696-raster full index was stale for four public-main heads; four open PR raster inventories were also not scanned.
findings_and_resolutions.resolution: Recorded a current 57-repository main-head check and open PR heads. The unchanged indexed universal-support witness is sufficient to STOP before production placement, not to claim a fresh full scan or candidate uniqueness PASS.

findings_and_resolutions.finding: A post-run fetch of origin/main showed PR #27 had merged the H6-1 2-px proximity-prune-versus-equal-count-random holdout at 22:00:49Z, before the branch-local S7-1 run. The local branch was still based at 5fd64ec and its pre-run audit had not fetched its own origin/main. The intervention family was therefore not repository-novel, despite the initial slate wording.
findings_and_resolutions.resolution: Preserved the H6-1 and S7-1 receipts separately; documented that they use different base allocators but the same underlying catalog/holdout; marked the novelty claim superseded; did not pool scores, promote either arm, or rerun either experiment.

findings_and_resolutions.finding: The merged H6-1 receipt also contained an evaluator-hash-matched unpruned E2 score of 0.1352037 on 11,321 positives, a current comparable best omitted from the branch-local pre-run gate audit. It exceeds S7-1 proximal DTI 0.1010050 by 0.0341987 pointwise.
findings_and_resolutions.resolution: Recorded the upstream best in the S7-1 receipt as post-run cross-branch context. Evaluator hashes match for the shared scoring modules. The point gap is descriptive only (no paired cross-model test was computed); S7-1 already fails the registered matched-random test. No promotion, pooling, or rerun.

passes.name: Recheck the original request, evidence labels, delivery gates, and site
checks: The one S7-1 buffered holdout ran once: evaluator gems57-pooled-hide-v2, 11,321 withheld positives, alpha=0.2, beta=0.8, 300 m triangular kernel, 1,000 paired spatial-block draws; no test truth chose emission.
All 13 feature-only canaries passed; maximum discriminative AUC was 0.8258665. Distance and relative-strike distributions are recorded as HOLDOUT-STRUCTURE, not scores.
The registered proximal-minus-random contrast was -0.0000020031 [95% CI -0.0000156476, +0.0000164644]; it does not support S7-1. No follow-up hypothesis ran.
The literal uniqueness blocker was not relaxed. No full production surface, production dots, candidate TIFF, TIFF SHA, candidate registry scan, validator, or submission slot was produced/used.

README and generated Overview, Download & Submit, and S7-1 pages prominently state that this S7-1 run produced no TIFF and that S7-1 download/submit are false. The separate H57-M artifact retains its own scoped research-download authorization in current main; submission remains NO.
scripts/check_site.py passed on 32 pages; the full pytest suite passed; git diff --check passed; no TIFF/ZIP was added or changed.

Post-merge audit found an already-merged H6-1 matched-pruning holdout in origin/main (PR #27); this branch-local S7-1 test is a different base allocator but not a novel or independent hypothesis test. Both paired proximal-minus-random intervals cross zero; the receipts remain separate.
Cross-branch reconciliation also found a hash-matched current E2 best at 0.1352037; S7-1 proximal is 0.1010050. This point comparison is descriptive only, with no paired cross-model inference.

final_decision.hypothesis_novelty: not repository-novel; initial pre-run claim superseded by cross-branch audit
